applicableAreas: West adjacent properties across Valley View Road
findings.comment: Adjoining land uses are not noted on all four sides. North (MF-2-CO), East (MF-2-CO), and South (Single Family) are labeled on Sheet 9. However, properties across Valley View Road to the west are not identified with land use designations on either the cover sheet location map or the Site Plan.

applicableAreas: Adjacent properties across Valley View Road (west)
findings.comment: Properties across Valley View Road (west side, across the right-of-way) are not identified on the site plan with land use or property designations. The cover sheet location map and Site Plan Sheet 9 do not show properties located across the street to the west.

Adjacent property zoning district designations are not shown on the site plan for the south side. The south adjacent property is identified only as 'Use: Single Family' without a zoning designation (e.g., SF-3). Per facts.md, the adjacent parcel (0406100210) is zoned SF-3, but this zoning designation does not appear on the submitted site plan.

Adjacent zoning designations shown on the site plan cannot be verified as accurate against current City GIS records from the submitted plan documents alone. Comparison with City of Austin GIS zoning database would be required to confirm accuracy.

Mylars are not included in the submitted plan set. The submission appears to be CAD-based with no separate mylar set provided. Unable to verify whether zoning designations are included on mylars as required.

applicableAreas: Adjacent properties within 50 feet of site boundary
findings.comment: Inconsistency exists between plan sheets regarding existing buildings on adjoining properties. Sheet 9 (Site Plan) depicts 'Existing Apartment Building' on the east side within 50 feet of the site boundary, while Sheet 4 (Existing Conditions Survey) shows no building outlines on any adjoining properties. Building presence and footprints on adjoining lots require clarification to properly evaluate this requirement.

Due to the discrepancy between Sheet 4 (which shows no adjacent buildings) and Sheet 9 (which shows an 'Existing Apartment Building' on the east), it is unclear whether buildings exist on adjoining lots within 50 feet. The required note stating 'no buildings exist on adjoining lots within 50 feet' is not present, but cannot be verified as necessary given the conflicting information on the plans.

The site plan includes trash collection notes but does not specify the location of the dumpster or refuse receptacle relative to adjacent properties. Sheet 9 notes that 'trash containers shall not be left at curbside unattended' but does not identify where the dumpster is located or provide dimensions showing its distance from the south adjacent property (SF-3). Distance from SF-5 or more restrictive zoning (20 feet required) cannot be verified without specific dumpster location callout.

applicableAreas: Exterior lighting locations above second floor
findings.comment: Fixture locations and heights for all exterior lighting are not shown on the site plan. Sheet 9 Block 1 states exterior lighting will comply with Subchapter E 2.5 and notes that 'any change or substitution of lamps/light fixtures shall be submitted to the Director for approval,' indicating fixture details are deferred to building plan review. Specific verification that no lighting above second floor faces residential property cannot be made from the site plan.

applicableAreas: Mechanical equipment locations and noise levels
findings.comment: No mechanical equipment schedule, noise ratings, or equipment location specifications are provided on the site plan. Equipment noise levels (required to be ≤70 dB(A) at property lines adjacent to residential) cannot be verified without a detailed mechanical equipment schedule showing equipment types, locations, and manufacturer noise ratings.
